description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the Draft of Irrigation Statute of Central Provincial Council, No. 5.of 2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (the Irrigation Statute of the Central Provincial Council No. 05 of 2017). It details the legal framework for establishing a Department of Irrigation, defining its powers and functions, and creating new regulatory bodies (Irrigation Management and Development Committees). While a minister's name and title are mentioned in the notification preamble, this is standard for legal promulgation and the core content is entirely focused on creating new laws and regulations, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The government personnel information is secondary to the primary purpose of publishing the statute.
